tokens.name: sky-far
tokens.usage: Top of the screen = far edge of the arena. Lightest background value; the haze the enemies come out of.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: Arena floor around the Core. The ground every in-arena number and enemy is checked against.

tokens.name: sky-near
tokens.usage: Bottom of the screen (nearest the thumb) and the vignette. Darkest value in the game: never pure black.

tokens.name: arena-ring
tokens.usage: Concentric arena rings = range bands (docs/12 §1): ring I Pulse reach 3.0, ring II short 5.5, ring III mid 7.5, edge 9.0 = gates. Drawn at 15–20% strength; the band a module reaches lights in its sector while dragging.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Bars, sheets and the veil behind cards. Solid, because translucent panels do not blend reliably on Android.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Offer cards, tooltips, mini windows: anything that sits above surface-glass.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1 dp hairline borders of glass panels and cards; outline of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: The Core, primary buttons and all primary text on sky-* and surface-* grounds.

tokens.name: ivory-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, effect lines, captions) on surface-glass and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ivory-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder dashes only; never for text the player must read.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ivory, gold, teal and mint fills (primary button label, rarity badge).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Weapon modules (pointed silhouettes), damage lines, DPS numbers.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side of weapon models; fill of the DPS share bar.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Booster modules (ring silhouettes), combo links, multipliers, rare cards, big hits.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side of booster models; rare-card border inner edge.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Economy modules (solid round silhouettes), Credits gained, interest.

tokens.name: mint-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side of economy models.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: ENEMIES ONLY: bodies, their threat chips, the Core-hit tint, an unaffordable cost. Never on Core, modules or player UI.

tokens.name: coral-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side of enemy shards; Brute's thick edge.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Elites (double halo) and Guardians: the only second danger tone. Told apart from coral by the halo and size, not by hue alone. ≥ 3:1 on sky-far in every act.

tokens.name: ally
tokens.usage: Allied Sprites from Nests (docs/12 §5): small glowing seeds that block enemies. Never used for enemies or player UI; ≥ 5:1 on every sky.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Key-light colour per act and the peak of an emissive fade (Pulse, merge). Never a flat fill.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Uncommon rarity border on offer cards.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 dp solid ring with a 2 dp gap for keyboard / controller focus and the tap-then-slot selection.

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: Wave-summary and run-end totals while they roll.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: Run-end title, Guardian name, act card.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Top bar (Integrity, wave, Credits) and card costs. Minimum size for numbers the player tracks.

styles.name: number-sm
styles.usage: In-arena damage numbers and preview deltas; always with a soft halo.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and sheet titles. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Module and enemy names in sheets and mini windows.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface text. Minimum 16 sp for sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels (≤ 12 characters in every language).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Card effect lines, section eyebrows (uppercase), stat labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between offer cards and between buttons in a row. The base grid step.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside offer cards and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left/right) and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a sheet; top-bar height padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above the primary action; section spacing on meta screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target edge.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Threat chips, badges, the rarity ribbon.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Offer cards, mini windows, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons (at 48–64 dp height this reads as a soft pill).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round controls: Pulse, speed, pause, toggles.

shadow.note: Shadows are cool and soft (never black) and are the only depth cue in the interface; no borders thicker than 1 dp.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Offer cards and mini windows at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card picked up by the finger (with scale 1.05, +12 dp).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-gold
tokens.usage: Merge, rare card, active combo. Fades in and out; never blinks.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-teal
tokens.usage: Pulse ready halo (0.3 → 0.6 → 0.3 over 2 s).

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (icon buttons, toggles, list rows).

tokens.name: size-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the one primary action per screen.

tokens.name: size-pulse
tokens.usage: Diameter of the Pulse button (the largest control in a wave).

tokens.name: size-card-w
tokens.usage: Offer card width (4 cards + 3 gaps inside a 360 dp screen).

tokens.name: size-card-h
tokens.usage: Offer card height.
